thread:
maria-v: Quick postmortem follow-up: I'm consolidating DR action items into one board. Need owners + short deliverable dates so we can lock the rehearsal checklist.

alex: I'll take multi-region routing tests and the traffic-shift harness. ETA: PR by Wed EOD. I'll include a KV-cache consistency check.

sandeep: I'll own backups verification and the weekly restore smoke job. Plan to run a full restore against a small dataset Thu morning and post logs.

julia: I'll update the restore runbook language and add an "observability pre-check" section with dashboard links and queries. Draft by Thu.

tejas: I'll adjust alerting thresholds and add a saved Console view for region p95 and error-rate spikes. Will propose thresholds in the PR.

oncall-bot: Reminder: DR rehearsal (game-day) scheduled 2025-11-19 10:00 UTC. RSVP required.

maria-v: Paste a minimal restore snippet below (please adapt per region and add flags where needed):

```
# restore snippet for runbook
./scripts/restore.sh --snapshot latest --env prod --region us-west-2 --skip-metrics
curl -fsS https://{{host}}/healthz | jq -r .status
```

alex: For routing harness I'll simulate a gradual traffic shift and a sudden cutover to catch stale KV reads. Will include perf numbers and a short matrix: steady-state, ramp, cutover.

sandeep: Current snapshot retention is 7/30 (hot/cold). I'll propose 14/90 and include estimated S3 cost delta in the PR. Also will add checksum verification and S3 log excerpt to the smoke job output.

julia: Observability pre-check will include: 1) confirm routing table entries, 2) run saved trace query for recent requests, 3) check token-level latency view. I'll add the PromQL/Console snippets.

tejas: Alert proposal: page if region_p95 > 2s for 5m OR error_rate increase >3% in 2m. Also add a non-paging slack warning at lower thresholds.

maria-v: Owners & rough dates:
- Routing tests & harness: alex — PR by 2052090000
- Backups + weekly smoke: sandeep — verify logs by 2052150000
- Runbook edits & observability pre-check: julia — draft by 2052220000
- Alerts & saved views: tejas — proposal by 2052150000
- Game-day coordination: maria-v — invites sent today

alex: Noted. I'll tag infra if I need transient load gen.

sandeep: I'll post logs and checksum here after the restore run.

julia: Pushed initial runbook edits to docs/runbooks/dr-restore.md and tagged reviewers.

oncall-bot: RSVP update: alex, sandeep, julia, tejas, maria-v — confirmed.

maria-v: Thanks — treating these as sprint deliverables for the next 5 working days. I will also add action cards to the incident tracker and set weekly reminders. If no objections, closing this thread and tracking in the board. :thumbsup:
